The fixture was SDK-created outside git with create, two updates and close. npm 2026.10.20 and 2026.10.27 SDK dispatch returned 4 full rows, while their CLI defaults returned compact rows. The test database is unavailable, so route verification uses the repository authorization-query stub pattern with real authenticated HTTP and real SDK trackers; no hosted services or Docker are accessed. Design: explicit compact summary projection (the panel uses operation/time, never patches), normalized oldest-first API rows, fixed page size and opaque backwards cursor, newest-first panel plus load older, and live refresh resets to the latest page. The native history query supports latest-entry limit but no backwards cursor, so older API pages will request only the needed bounded latest suffix and trim it before responding.
